query:
SELECT
                bt.id AS token_id,
                b.id AS bot_id,
                b.kind,
                b.owner_user_id,
                b.team_id
            FROM bot_tokens bt
            JOIN bots b ON b.id = bt.bot_id
            WHERE bt.token_hash = $1
              AND bt.revoked_at IS NULL
              AND (bt.expires_at IS NULL OR bt.expires_at > now())
              AND b.deleted_at IS NULL
